market_summary: Across all monitored assets (XAUUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD), markets experienced strong New York session downside flushes earlier in the day and are now entering a low-volume consolidation phase below their respective session Value Areas (VAL) and VWAP baselines. With RVOL suppressed below 1.0 on all pairs and volatility bands contracting or consolidating post-expansion, momentum has stalled near session lows. In the absence of fresh catalytic volume or structural triggers, disciplined patience and a complete HOLD stance is maintained across the board.
